text: Beautiful inside and out.  We stayed right across the courtyard and loved looking at this cathedral.    Shopping, restaurants and music in the courtyard were fun too.  Loved it!  We just did a self guided tour.
author: Terri_R

title: Memorable!
text: The Barcelona Cathedral is a must-see. Its Gothic architecture is impressive: every facade, arch, and detail conveys centuries of history. Inside, you feel a special mix of solemnity, peace, and awe that invites you to explore it calmly. The staff was friendly and willing to provide guidance during the visit. I especially recommend going up to the rooftop: the views of the city and the possibility of seeing the towers and other architectural details up close make the experience even more memorable.

title: A better outcome from a self-guided tour
text: The self-guided tour for the Cathedral of Barcelona has been effective for us as we valued more the flexibility,  the stress-free and exploring at our own pace approach. The self-guided audio enabled us to have the perfect balance of independence/freedom and insights. Will highly recommend.
author: Bella_M

title: Gothic masterpiece!
text: Beautiful Gothic masterpiece. The cathedral is worth it and the top is gorgeous. There is a rooftop view and you can sit on benches at the top and take pictures by the towers. The inside has multiple saints you can pay your respects to and there is a shop you can buy rosary’s and prayer cards and religious gifts towards the end. There is beautiful little pond by the store and it has swans. Overall it was a beautiful place and I had a good time and wanted to capture everything.
author: Daniella_D
